summary: This article explains how goal-line cameras, VAR, offside tracking, and player trackers help football referees and coaches make the game fairer and safer.
introduce: Show the title “Technology on the Football Pitch” and give pairs one minute to list everything they already know about this topic. Share a few ideas on the board, then tell students to check which ideas the article confirms.

keyTerms.def: machines and tools made using science
a choice you make after thinking
in football, being in a place on the pitch that is not allowed when the ball is passed

challengeTerms.def: a strong public disagreement about something
the quality of being very exact
a screen that shows pictures or information

discussion: Do you agree or disagree that technology makes football better to watch? Use evidence from the article to explain.
Which tool in the article do you think helps football the most?
struggling: Read the first part of the article aloud together, review technology, decision, and offside, and let weak readers use a K-W-L chart and read the article with a partner.
gifted: Ask strong readers to read a challenging version and write a short paragraph that uses controversy, precision, and monitor to connect the article to something they learned in another subject.
